info.title: Seed Chat Completions — API reference
info.description: Parameters and advanced features of Chat Completions for Seed models.

post.description:
- Call Seed with the OpenAI SDK.
- Synchronous requests return the reply directly.
- Use single- or multi-turn text chat and set the assistant’s role with a system prompt.
- Messages for multi-turn conversations. Mix text, images and video. Only `doubao-seed-2-1-lite` also accepts audio.
- Reasoning is on by default. You can disable it or adjust its depth.
- List of tools the model may request. This endpoint accepts only `function` tools.
- Return structured JSON with JSON Object or JSON Schema.
- Web search is available via [Responses](/en/api-manual/language-series/doubao-seed-2.0/doubao-seed-2.0-responses-reference) or [Messages](/en/api-manual/language-series/doubao-seed-2.0/doubao-seed-2.0-messages-reference) on Seed 2.1 and `doubao-seed-evolving`. Chat Completions does not offer it.
- [Quickstart](/en/api-manual/language-series/doubao-seed-2.0/doubao-seed-2.0-quickstart)

model.description:
Choose a model

| Model ID | Use case | Context window |
|---|---|---|
| `doubao-seed-2-1-pro` | Recommended flagship for complex reasoning, long documents and codebases | 1,000,000 tokens |
| `doubao-seed-2-1-turbo` | Low-cost option for chat, extraction and agent tasks | 256,000 tokens |
| `doubao-seed-2-1-lite` | Lowest-priced Seed 2.1 model, with audio input | 1,000,000 tokens |
| `doubao-seed-evolving` | Updated weekly for evaluating new capabilities | 1,000,000 tokens |
| `doubao-seed-2.0-pro` | Seed 2.0 flagship | 256,000 tokens |
| `doubao-seed-2.0-lite` | Fast, lightweight Seed 2.0 model | 256,000 tokens |
| `doubao-seed-2.0-mini` | Fastest Seed 2.0 model for simple tasks | 256,000 tokens |
| `doubao-seed-2.0-code` | Seed 2.0 model for coding | 256,000 tokens |

Seed 2.1 model IDs use a hyphen (`2-1`). Seed 2.0 IDs use a period (`2.0`).

messages.description: Messages for multi-turn conversations. Mix text, images and video. Only `doubao-seed-2-1-lite` also accepts audio.

thinking.description: Controls whether the model enables deep thinking mode

type.description: With `enabled`, the model reasons before answering (default for all Seed models). With `disabled`, it answers directly. Reasoning tokens count as output and are billed at the output rate.

stream.description:
Whether to stream the response content

- `false`: Model generates all content before returning the result at once
- `true`: Returns model-generated content incrementally via SSE protocol, ending with a `data: [DONE]` message. When stream is true, you can set the stream_options field to get token usage statistics

stream_options.description: Options for streaming responses. Can be set when stream is true

include_usage.description:
Whether to output token usage information before streaming output ends

- `true`: Before the `data: [DONE]` message, an additional chunk will be returned with the usage field containing total token usage for the entire request, and an empty choices array
- `false`: No chunk is returned with token usage information before output ends

chunk_include_usage.description:
Whether each chunk in streaming output includes cumulative token usage information up to that point

- `true`: The usage field in each returned chunk contains cumulative token usage from the start of the request to the current chunk
- `false`: Token usage information is not included in each chunk

max_tokens.description: Maximum answer tokens. Reasoning is outside this limit and billed as output, so total output can substantially exceed it. To cap both, use `max_completion_tokens` instead or disable reasoning. The answer ceiling is 256K for Seed 2.1 and `doubao-seed-evolving`, and 128K for Seed 2.0. Do not combine with `max_completion_tokens`.

max_completion_tokens.description: Maximum combined answer and reasoning tokens, from 1 to 65536. Overrides the default `max_tokens`. The model generates as needed up to this limit. Recommended with reasoning. Do not set both parameters.

temperature.description:
Sampling temperature, controls output randomness

**Note**:
- Value range: [0, 2]
- Lower values (e.g., 0.2): More deterministic, more focused output
- Higher values (e.g., 0.8): More random, more creative output
- A value of 0 means the model only considers the token with the highest log probability
- It is recommended to adjust only temperature or top_p, not both

top_p.description:
Nucleus sampling probability threshold

**Note**:
- Value range: [0, 1]
- The model considers tokens within the top_p probability mass
- 0.1 means only considering the top 10% of tokens by probability mass
- Higher values produce more random output, lower values produce more deterministic output
- It is recommended to adjust only temperature or top_p, not both

stop.description:
The model will stop generating when it encounters the string(s) specified in the stop field. The stop string itself will not be included in the output. Up to 4 strings are supported

**Note**: Deep thinking models do not support this field

reasoning_effort.description:
Lower reasoning effort can improve speed and reduce reasoning tokens.

Reasoning effort: `minimal` answers directly, `low` prioritizes speed, `medium` balances speed and depth, and `high` analyzes complex problems in depth.

Seed 2.1 and `doubao-seed-evolving` default to `high`. Seed 2.0 defaults to `medium`. The alias `none` maps to `minimal`, and `xhigh` and `max` map to `high`.

response_format.description:
Specify the model response format

Supports three formats: text (default), json_object, json_schema

type.description:
Response format type

- `text`: Default text format
- `json_object`: Model response content is organized as a JSON object structure
- `json_schema`: Model response content follows the JSON structure defined in the schema field

json_schema.description: JSON structure definition (required when type is json_schema)

description.description: Description of the response purpose; the model will use this to determine how to respond in the specified format

schema.description: JSON format definition for the response, described as a JSON Schema object

strict.description:
Whether to enable strict adherence mode

- `true`: The model will always strictly follow the format defined in the schema field
- `false`: The model will try its best to follow the structure defined in the schema field

frequency_penalty.description:
Frequency penalty coefficient

**Note**:
- Value range: [-2.0, 2.0]
- Positive values penalize new tokens based on their frequency in the text so far, reducing the likelihood of the model repeating the same content verbatim

presence_penalty.description:
Presence penalty coefficient

**Note**:
- Value range: [-2.0, 2.0]
- Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they have appeared in the text so far, increasing the likelihood of the model talking about new topics

logprobs.description:
Whether to return log probabilities of output tokens

- `false`: Do not return log probability information
- `true`: Return log probabilities for each output token in the message content

**Note**: Deep thinking models do not support this field

top_logprobs.description:
Specify the number of most likely tokens to return at each output token position, each with an associated log probability

- Value range: [0, 20]
- Can only be set when logprobs is true

**Note**: Deep thinking models do not support this field

logit_bias.description:
Adjust the probability of specified tokens appearing in the model output

**Note**:
- Accepts a map where keys are token IDs from the vocabulary and values are bias values
- Bias value range: [-100, 100]
- -1 reduces the likelihood of selection, 1 increases the likelihood of selection
- -100 completely prohibits selection of the token, 100 causes only that token to be selectable

**Note**: Deep thinking models do not support this field

tools.description: List of tools the model may request. This endpoint accepts only `function` tools.

parallel_tool_calls.description:
Whether the model response is allowed to contain multiple tool calls for this request

- `true`: Allow returning multiple tool calls
- `false`: The number of tool calls returned is <= 1

tool_choice.description:
Whether the model response should contain tool calls for this request

**String mode**:
- `none`: Model response does not contain tool calls
- `required`: Model response must contain tool calls
- `auto`: Model decides whether to include tool calls (default when tools are provided)

**Object mode**: Specify the scope of tools to be called

role.description:
Message role

- `user`: User message
- `assistant`: AI assistant message (for multi-turn conversations)
- `system`: System prompt (define AI role and behavior)
- `tool`: Tool response message (for tool calling scenarios)

content.description: Pass a plain string (for example, `"content": "Introduce yourself"`) or an array of text, image or video objects. Only `doubao-seed-2-1-lite` also supports audio objects.

reasoning_content.description:
Chain-of-thought content in model messages (assistant role only)

Only used when passing historical chain-of-thought content in multi-turn conversations

tool_calls.description: Tool call part of model messages (assistant role only)

tool_call_id.description:
Tool call request ID generated by the model (required for tool role only)

Used to associate tool return results with model requests, avoiding confusion in multi-tool call scenarios

text.example: Please describe this image in detail

url.description:
Image URL or Base64 encoding

**Supported formats**:
- Image link (publicly accessible)
- Base64 encoded image

detail.description:
Image understanding detail level

- `low`: Low detail
- `high`: High detail
- `xhigh`: Ultra-high detail

url.description:
Video URL or Base64 encoding

**Supported formats**:
- Video link (publicly accessible)
- Base64 encoded video

**Note**: Audio content within the video is not supported for understanding

fps.description:
Frame extraction rate

- Value range: [0.2, 5]
- Higher values make the model more sensitive to visual changes in the video
- Lower values make the model less sensitive to visual changes, but consume fewer tokens and are faster

type.description: Tool type, currently only supports function

name.description: Name of the function to call

description.description: Description of the function; the model will use this to determine whether to call this tool

parameters.description:
Function request parameters, described in JSON Schema format

**Note**:
- All field names are case-sensitive
- parameters must be a valid JSON Schema object
- It is recommended to use English field names and put Chinese descriptions in the description field

ToolChoiceObject.description: Specify the scope of tools to be called

name.description: Name of the tool to be called

id.description: ID of the called tool, generated by the model

type.description: Tool type, currently only supports function

name.description: Name of the function to call

arguments.description:
Arguments for the function to call, in JSON format

**Note**: The model does not always generate valid JSON and may hallucinate parameters that are not defined. It is recommended to validate parameters before calling the function

created.description: Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when this request was created

choices.description: Model output content for this request

index.description: Index of the current element in the choices list

finish_reason.description:
Reason why the model stopped generating tokens

- `stop`: Model output ended naturally, or was truncated due to hitting a string specified in the stop parameter
- `length`: Model output was truncated due to reaching max_tokens / max_completion_tokens / context length limit
- `content_filter`: Model output was blocked by content moderation
- `tool_calls`: Model called a tool

logprobs.description: Log probability information for the current content

content.description: Token log probability information for each content element

moderation_hit_type.description:
When model output contains sensitive content, returns the matched risk classification label

- `severe_violation`: Model output involves severe violation
- `violence`: Model output involves violent behavior

role.description: Role of the content output, always assistant

content.description: Message content generated by the model
content.example: Hello! I’m a Seed language model for reasoning, writing, coding and multimodal understanding…

reasoning_content.description:
Chain-of-thought content from the model's problem-solving process

Only returned when deep thinking mode is enabled

tool_calls.description: Tool calls generated by the model

bytes.description: UTF-8 value of the current token, as a list of integers

logprob.description: Log probability of the current token

top_logprobs.description: List of the most likely tokens at the current token position and their log probabilities

bytes.description: UTF-8 value of the current token

logprob.description: Log probability of the current token

total_tokens.description: Total number of tokens consumed by this request (input + output)

prompt_tokens.description: Total input tokens, including cache hits.

cached_tokens.description: Input tokens served from cache, billed at the cache-hit rate.

audio_tokens.description: Audio input tokens, returned only for audio requests to `doubao-seed-2-1-lite`.

audio_cached_tokens.description: Audio input tokens served from cache on audio requests to `doubao-seed-2-1-lite`.

reasoning_tokens.description: Number of tokens consumed by chain-of-thought output

AudioContent.title: Audio input (`doubao-seed-2-1-lite` only)
AudioContent.description:
Only `doubao-seed-2-1-lite` accepts audio. Other models return `400`.

- Formats: mp3, wav, aac and m4a. Up to 25 MB per file and 120 minutes total per request.
- Audio is billed separately at about 6.25 audio tokens per second. Cached audio has a lower rate. See model pricing.

input_audio.description: Supply either `url` or `data` for the audio.

data.description: Base64 audio without a `data:` prefix. Include `format` when using `data`.

bearerAuth.description:
## All APIs require Bearer Token authentication ##

**Get API Key:**

Visit [API Key Management Page](https://evolink.ai/dashboard/keys) to get your API Key

**Add to request header:**
```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```
